headlines.title: APM Terminals and Port of Rotterdam prepare terminal expansion
headlines.content_summary: APM Terminals Maasvlakte II and the Port of Rotterdam Authority are preparing a new phase of expansion at the Maasvlakte II container terminal. It will add 25 hectares of terminal area, about 711 metres of additional quay and supporting port infrastructure, and is expected to raise annual capacity by roughly 1.4 million TEU once complete. headlines.title: Oil Rises as Houthis Attack Two Saudi Ports on Red Sea
headlines.content_summary: Oil extended gains as Iran-backed Houthi rebels continued to target Saudi Arabia, including a refinery at Ras Tanura and the Red Sea ports of Jeddah and Jazan. Meanwhile, the United Arab Emirates said it plans to expand power and water desalination on its eastern coast, beyond the Strait of Hormuz, as war exposes Persian Gulf vulnerabilities. Stuart Livingstone-Wallace reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
